This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Nampi" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal sentient species was distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|purple]] skin, pair of [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] situated at the top of their faces, and a lack of visible [[Nose/Legends|noses]].<ref name="Nampi" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]], a number of members of this species served as guards for [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Nampi]],<ref name="Nampi" /> though all of these guards were executed by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] following their bosses' death at his hands.<ref name="Dynasty">''[[Jabba the Hutt: The Dynasty Trap]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[1995]] comic book ''[[Jabba the Hutt: The Hunger of Princess Nampi]]'', written by [[Jim Woodring]] and illustrated by [[Art Wetherell]].<ref name="Marvel Release">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54270/star_wars_jabba_the_hutt_-_the_hunger_of_princess_nampi_1995_1|text=Star Wars: Jabba the Hutt - The Hunger of Princess Nampi (1995) #1}}</ref>
